title: Identifying Barriers Hindering the Acceptance of Generative AI as a Work Associate, measured with the new AGAWA scale
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It develops the AGAWA scale to measure attitudes towards Generative AI as a work associate, focusing on factors like anxiety and belief in human uniqueness.
base_benchmarks: BHNU (Belief in Human Nature and Uniqueness Scale)
UTAUT (Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology)
GAAIS (General Attitudes toward Artificial Intelligence Scale)
TrAAIT (Theory of Trust and Acceptance of Artificial Intelligence Technology)
findings: No findings related to religion were reported as it was not a focus of the study. A cited reference mentions 'religiousness' as a factor in attitudes towards social robots in a different study, but this was not investigated in the current paper.
